clips.title: The story
paras: The High Seat is the grand throne room of Ironforge, situated between the Commons and the Great Forge. From this elevated chamber, King Magni Bronzebeard presides over the dwarven realm alongside his royal advisors and historians. The room also houses the sealed passageway leading down into the ancient depths of Old Ironforge.

Overlooking the vibrant bustling rings of Ironforge, the High Seat serves as the royal seat of power for the kingdom of Khaz Modan. Within this vaulted chamber, King Magni Bronzebeard hears petitioners, holds council with his advisors, and directs the defense of the Alliance's northern bastions. Flanked by royal dignitaries such as Royal Historian Archesonus and Senator Barin Redstone, the High Seat remains a symbol of unyielding Bronzebeard authority and dwarven resilience amid troubling times across Azeroth.

Behind the majestic stone appointments of the throne room lies a heavy doorway leading into the shadowy expanse of Old Ironforge. These lower ruins represent the original, ancestral halls carved out by the dwarves before the city was reconfigured around the Great Forge. Guarded and sealed to general traffic, the portal reminds visitors of the vast antiquity and cavernous history resting beneath the modern capital's stones.
